title: Pushing slope- to plateau-type behavior in hard carbon for sodium-ion batteries via local structure rearrangement
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4312-4323
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00104H, Paper
Feng Wang, Lian Chen, Jiaqi Wei, Caozheng Diao, Fan Li, Congcong Du, Zhengshuai Bai, Yanyan Zhang, Oleksandr I. Malyi, Xiaodong Chen, Yuxin Tang, Xiaojun Bao
Pushing slope- to plateau-type behavior is related to the transition from a critical interlayer distance to an average crystallite width of graphitic domain control, and is limited by the closed pore volume of hard carbon.
